question: What Is Ladder Logic in PLC Programming?
body_html:
Ladder logic is a graphical PLC programming language in which contacts (inputs) and coils (outputs) are drawn between two vertical rails, like a relay wiring diagram. Each horizontal row is a rung.

SymbolNameFunction
[ ]NO contactPasses power when the input is ON
[/]NC contactPasses power when the input is OFF
( )Output coilTurns the output ON when the rung is true

The PLC scans rungs top to bottom, typically every 1 to 50 ms..
